items.name: Stable System
items.definition: Stable System：A dynamic system with a bounded response to a bounded input.

items.name: Resonant frequency
items.definition: Resonant frequency：The resonant frequency ω_r and the -3 dB bandwidth can be related to the speed of the transient response.
